zIndex.$description: Named stacking layers, lowest to highest (design §3.3; ADR 0004 replaces raw z-index 1..1010). [derived] The order is design §3.3's own (no research source); numbers are anchored to current packages/vue usage so migration keeps today's stacking.

chartOverlay.$description: Overlays inside the chart frame; today 10-31 (KLineTooltip, MarkerTooltip, chart HUD layers).

dropdown.$description: Dropdown menus. [derived] first slot above sticky.

modal.$description: Modal dialogs. [derived] slot between popover and tooltip.

toast.$description: Toasts. [derived] slot between modal and tooltip.
